title: अष्टादशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 18 · The fruit of reciting Shiva's praise

summary.en: Krishna Dvaipayana tells his son Shuka to recite it, and the sages Jaigishavya, Gargya, Parashara, Mandavya and Galava tell each what he gained from worshipping Shiva. Krishna tells how Upamanyu had been born a deer and found grace, and gives the fruit of the praise, a stay in heaven for as many thousand years as there are pores on the body.
summary.kn: ವ್ಯಾಸ ಮಗ ಶುಕನಿಗೆ ಪಠಿಸಲು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಜೈಗೀಷವ್ಯ, ಗಾರ್ಗ್ಯ, ಪರಾಶರ, ಮಾಂಡವ್ಯ, ಗಾಲವ ಶಿವನ ಆರಾಧನೆಯಿಂದ ಪಡೆದುದನ್ನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಉಪಮನ್ಯು ಜಿಂಕೆಯಾಗಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಿ ಕೃಪೆ ಪಡೆದುದನ್ನು ಕೃಷ್ಣ ಹೇಳಿ ದೇಹದ ರೋಮಕೂಪಗಳಷ್ಟು ಸಾವಿರ ವರ್ಷ ಸ್ವರ್ಗವಾಸ ಫಲವೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: व्यास पुत्र शुक से इसका पाठ करने को कहते हैं, और जैगीषव्य, गार्ग्य, पराशर, माण्डव्य और गालव शिव की उपासना से अपने-अपने पाए फल बताते हैं। कृष्ण बताते हैं कि उपमन्यु मृग रूप में जन्मे और कृपा पाई, और स्तुति का फल देह के जितने रोमकूप हैं उतने हजार वर्ष स्वर्गवास कहते हैं।
summary.te: వ్యాసుడు కొడుకు శుకునికి పఠించమని చెబుతాడు; జైగీషవ్యుడు, గార్గ్యుడు, పరాశరుడు, మాండవ్యుడు, గాలవుడు శివారాధనతో పొందినవాటిని చెబుతారు. ఉపమన్యుడు జింకగా పుట్టి కృపను పొందాడని కృష్ణుడు చెప్పి దేహంలోని రోమకూపాల సంఖ్య వేల ఏళ్లు స్వర్గవాసం ఫలమని అంటాడు.
summary.ta: வியாசர் மகன் சுகரை ஓதச் சொல்ல, ஜைகீஷவ்யர், கார்க்யர், பராசரர், மாண்டவ்யர், காலவர் சிவ வழிபாட்டால் பெற்றதைக் கூறுகின்றனர். உபமன்யு மானாகப் பிறந்து அருள் பெற்றதைக் கூறி, உடலின் மயிர்க்கால்கள் அளவு ஆயிரம் ஆண்டுகள் சொர்க்கவாசம் இதன் பலன் என்கிறார்.
summary.ml: കൃഷ്ണദ്വൈപായനനായ വ്യാസൻ തന്റെ പുത്രനായ ശുകനോട് അത് ജപിക്കാൻ പറയുന്നു; ജൈഗീഷവ്യൻ, ഗാർഗ്യൻ, പരാശരൻ, മാണ്ഡവ്യൻ, ഗാലവൻ എന്നീ മുനിമാർ ശിവനെ ആരാധിച്ചതിന്റെ ഫലം ഓരോരുത്തരും പറയുന്നു. ഉപമന്യു ഒരു മാനായി ജനിച്ചിട്ടും കൃപ നേടിയതെങ്ങനെയെന്ന് കൃഷ്ണൻ പറയുന്നു; സ്തോത്രത്തിന്റെ ഫലമായി ശരീരത്തിലെ രോമകൂപങ്ങളുടെ എണ്ണത്തോളം ആയിരം വർഷം സ്വർഗത്തിൽ വസിക്കാമെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.18; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
महायोगी ततः प्राह कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः ।
पठस्व पुत्र भद्रं ते प्रीयतां ते महेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: Then the great yogi, the sage Krishna Dvaipayana, said: 'Recite it, my son; may good come to you and may Maheshvara be pleased with you.

verses.text:
पुरा पुत्र मया मेरौ तप्यता परमं तपः ।
पुत्रहेतोर्महाराज स्तव एषोऽनुकीर्तितः ॥

meaning.en: Long ago, my son, while I practiced supreme austerity on Meru for the sake of a son, great king, I sang this hymn in praise.

verses.text:
लब्धवानस्मि तान्कामानहं वै पाण्डुनन्दन ।
तथा त्वमपि शर्वाद्धि सर्वान्कामानवाप्स्यसि ॥

meaning.en: I obtained those desires, son of Pandu, and so you too will obtain all your desires from Sharva.'

verses.text:
चतुःशीर्षस्ततः प्राह शक्रस्य दयितः सखा ।
आलम्बायन इत्येव विश्रुतः करुणात्मकः ॥

meaning.en: Then the four-headed one, the dear friend of Indra, known as Alambayana and compassionate by nature, spoke.

verses.text:
मया गोकर्णमासाद्य तपस्तप्त्वा शतं समाः ।
अयोनिजानां दान्तानां धर्मज्ञानां सुवर्चसाम् ॥

meaning.en: He said: 'Having gone to Gokarna and practiced austerity for a hundred years, I received long ago from Sharva, prince of Pandu's line, a hundred sons,

verses.text:
अजराणामदुःखानां शतवर्षसहस्रिणाम् ।
लब्धं पुत्रशतं शर्वात्पुरा पाण्डुनृपात्मज ॥

meaning.en: who were not born of a womb, self-controlled, knowers of dharma, brilliant, ageless, free of sorrow, and each living a hundred thousand years.'

verses.text:
वाल्मीकिश्चापि भगवान्युधिष्ठिरमभाषत ।
विवादे साम्नि मुनिभिर्ब्रह्मघ्नो वै भवानिति ।
उक्तः क्षणेन चाविष्टस्तेनाधर्मेण भारत ॥

meaning.en: The blessed Valmiki too spoke to Yudhishthira: 'In a dispute over a Sama chant, the sages told me, "You are a killer of a brahmin." Bharata, in that very moment that sin seized me.

verses.text:
सोऽहमीशानमनघमस्तौषं शरणं गतः ।
मुक्तश्चास्म्यवशः पापात्ततो दुःखविनाशनः ।
आह मां त्रिपुरघ्नो वै यशस्तेऽग्र्यं भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: So I sought refuge and praised the sinless Ishana; helpless as I was, I was freed from the sin, and the destroyer of sorrow, the slayer of Tripura, told me, "You will have foremost fame."'

verses.text:
जामदग्न्यश्च कौन्तेयमाह धर्मभृतां वरः ।
ऋषिमध्ये स्थितस्तात तपन्निव विभावसुः ॥

meaning.en: Jamadagni's son, best of the upholders of dharma, spoke to the son of Kunti, sitting amid the sages and blazing like the sun.

verses.text:
पितृविप्रवधेनाहमार्तो वै पाण्डवाग्रज ।
शुचिर्भूत्वा महादेवं गतवाञ्शरणं नृप ॥

meaning.en: 'Elder brother of the Pandavas, I was tormented by the killing of my father, a brahmin. I purified myself and went to Mahadeva for refuge, O king.

verses.text:
नामभिश्चास्तुवं देवं ततस्तुष्टोऽभवद्भवः ।
परशुं च ददौ देवो दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि चैव मे ॥

meaning.en: I praised the God with his names, and then Bhava was pleased. The God gave me an axe and divine weapons.

verses.text:
पापं न भविता तेऽद्य अजेयश्च भविष्यसि ।
न ते प्रभविता मृत्युर्यशस्वी च भविष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: He said, "No sin shall touch you today; you will be unconquerable; death will have no power over you; and you will be famed."

verses.text:
आह मां भगवानेवं शिखण्डी शिवविग्रहः ।
यदवाप्तं च मे सर्वं प्रसादात्तस्य धीमतः ॥

meaning.en: The Blessed One, crested and of Shiva's form, spoke to me so, and all that I have gained is by the grace of that wise lord.'

verses.text:
असितो देवलश्चैव प्राह पाण्डुसुतं नृपम् ।
शापाच्छक्रस्य कौन्तेय चितो धर्मोऽनशन्मम ।
तन्मे धर्मं यशश्चाग्र्यमायुश्चैवाददद्भवः ॥

meaning.en: Asita Devala said to the king, the son of Pandu: 'Son of Kunti, by Indra's curse my merit was destroyed; Bhava gave me back that merit, foremost fame and long life.'

verses.text:
ऋषिर्गृत्समदो नाम शक्रस्य दयितः सखा ।
प्राहाजमीढं भगवान्बृहस्पतिसमद्युतिः ॥

meaning.en: The sage Gritsamada, a dear friend of Indra, blessed and radiant like Brihaspati, spoke to Ajamidha, Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
वसिष्ठो नाम भगवांश्चाक्षुषस्य मनोः सुतः ।
शतक्रतोरचिन्त्यस्य सत्रे वर्षसहस्रिके ।
वर्तमानेऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं साम्नि ह्युच्चारिते मया ॥

meaning.en: The blessed Vasishtha, son of Manu Chakshusha, said to me, 'While the thousand-year sacrifice of the unfathomable Indra was in progress and I had chanted a Sama verse,

verses.text:
रथन्तरं द्विजश्रेष्ठ न सम्यगिति वर्तते ।
समीक्षस्व पुनर्बुद्ध्या हर्षं त्यक्त्वा द्विजोत्तम ।
अयज्ञवाहिनं पापमकार्षीस्त्वं सुदुर्मते ॥

meaning.en: the Rathantara, best of brahmins, is not rightly chanted. Think again with your mind, putting aside your joy, excellent brahmin. You have done an evil that brings no benefit to the sacrifice, you fool.'

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा महाक्रोधात्प्राह रुष्टः पुनर्वचः ।
प्रज्ञया रहितो दुःखी नित्यं भीतो वनेचरः ।
दश वर्षसहस्राणि दशाष्टौ च शतानि च ॥

meaning.en: Having said this in great anger, the enraged sage spoke again: 'Bereft of wisdom, sorrowful, always afraid, roaming the forest, for ten thousand and eighteen hundred years,

verses.text:
नष्टपानीययवसे मृगैरन्यैश्च वर्जिते ।
अयज्ञीयद्रुमे देशे रुरुसिंहनिषेविते ।
भविता त्वं मृगः क्रूरो महादुःखसमन्वितः ॥

meaning.en: in a land with no water or fodder, empty of deer and other beasts, with trees unfit for sacrifice, where ruru deer and lions live, you will be a cruel deer, burdened with great sorrow.'

verses.text:
तस्य वाक्यस्य निधने पार्थ जातो ह्यहं मृगः ।
ततो मां शरणं प्राप्तं प्राह योगी महेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: Son of Pritha, at the end of his words I was born as a deer. Then, as I sought refuge, the yogi Maheshvara spoke to me.

verses.text:
अजरश्चामरश्चैव भविता दुःखवर्जितः ।
साम्यं समस्तु ते सौख्यं युवयोर्वर्धतां क्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: 'You will be ageless, deathless and free of sorrow. Let there be harmony between you two, happiness for you, and let your sacrifice flourish.'

verses.text:
अनुग्रहानेवमेष करोति भगवान्विभुः ।
परं धाता विधाता च सुखदुःखे च सर्वदा ॥

meaning.en: The Blessed Lord, the all-pervading, shows such favors; he is the supreme Maker and Ordainer, and always the source of pleasure and pain.

verses.text:
अचिन्त्य एष भगवान्कर्मणा मनसा गिरा ।
न मे तात युधिश्रेष्ठ विद्यया पण्डितः समः ॥

meaning.en: This Blessed One is unthinkable in deed, thought and speech. No learned man, dear best of Yudhishthira, equals me in knowledge.

verses.text: जैगीषव्य उवाच

meaning.en: Jaigishavya said:

verses.text:
ममाष्टगुणमैश्वर्यं दत्तं भगवता पुरा ।
यत्नेनाल्पेन बलिना वाराणस्यां युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: In the past the Blessed One gave me the eightfold power, though my effort at Varanasi was small, Yudhishthira.

verses.text: गार्ग्य उवाच

meaning.en: Gargya said:

verses.text:
चतुःषष्ट्यङ्गमददात्कालज्ञानं ममाद्भुतम् ।
सरस्वत्यास्तटे तुष्टो मनोयज्ञेन पाण्डव ॥

meaning.en: Pleased by a mental sacrifice on the bank of the Sarasvati, he gave me the wondrous knowledge of time with sixty-four divisions, Pandava.

verses.text:
तुल्यं मम सहस्रं तु सुतानां ब्रह्मवादिनाम् ।
आयुश्चैव सपुत्रस्य संवत्सरशतायुतम् ॥

meaning.en: He gave me a thousand sons equal to myself, speakers of Brahman, and a life of a hundred times ten thousand years for me with my sons.

verses.text: पराशर उवाच

meaning.en: Parashara said:

verses.text:
प्रसाद्याहं पुरा शर्वं मनसाचिन्तयं नृप ।
महातपा महातेजा महायोगी महायशाः ।
वेदव्यासः श्रियावासो ब्रह्मण्यः करुणात्मकः ॥

meaning.en: Long ago, king, having won Sharva's favor, I thought in my mind of a son who would be a great ascetic, of great radiance, a great yogi and greatly famed, Vedavyasa, a home of fortune, devoted to brahmins and compassionate.

verses.text:
अपि नामेप्सितः पुत्रो मम स्याद्वै महेश्वरात् ।
इति मत्वा हृदि मतं प्राह मां सुरसत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: Thinking, 'Might I have the son I wish from Maheshvara,' I held it in my heart, and the best of gods spoke to me about my wish.

verses.text:
मयि संभवतस्तस्य फलात्कृष्णो भविष्यति ।
सावर्णस्य मनोः सर्गे सप्तर्षिश्च भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: He said, 'Krishna will be born from me as fruit of your wish; in the creation of Manu Savarna he will be one of the seven sages.

verses.text:
वेदानां च स वै व्यस्ता कुरुवंशकरस्तथा ।
इतिहासस्य कर्ता च पुत्रस्ते जगतो हितः ॥

meaning.en: He will be the divider of the Vedas, the one who gives the Kuru line, and the author of the Itihasa; your son will benefit the world.

verses.text:
भविष्यति महेन्द्रस्य दयितः स महामुनिः ।
अजरश्चामरश्चैव पराशर सुतस्तव ॥

meaning.en: Parashara, that great sage, your son, will be dear to Mahendra, and ageless and immortal.'

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ।
युधिष्ठिर महायोगी वीर्यवानक्षयोऽव्ययः ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, the Blessed One vanished right there, Yudhishthira, the great yogi, mighty, undecaying and imperishable.

verses.text: माण्डव्य उवाच

meaning.en: Mandavya said:

verses.text:
अचौरश्चौरशङ्कायां शूले भिन्नो ह्यहं यदा ।
तत्रस्थेन स्तुतो देवः प्राह मां वै महेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: When I was impaled on a stake, though not a thief, on suspicion of theft, I praised the God while stuck there, and Maheshvara spoke to me.

verses.text:
मोक्षं प्राप्स्यसि शूलाच्च जीविष्यसि समार्बुदम् ।
रुजा शूलकृता चैव न ते विप्र भविष्यति ।
आधिभिर्व्याधिभिश्चैव वर्जितस्त्वं भविष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: 'You will be freed from the stake and live a full arbuda of years. The pain caused by the stake will not trouble you, brahmin; you will be free of mental and bodily ailments.

verses.text:
पादाच्चतुर्थात्संभूत आत्मा यस्मान्मुने तव ।
त्वं भविष्यस्यनुपमो जन्म वै सफलं कुरु ॥

meaning.en: Sage, since your self was born from a quarter of my foot, you will be peerless. Make your birth fruitful.

verses.text:
तीर्थाभिषेकं सफलं त्वमविघ्नेन चाप्स्यसि ।
स्वर्गं चैवाक्षयं विप्र विदधामि तवोर्जितम् ॥

meaning.en: You will perform your pilgrim bathing fruitfully and without hindrance, and I ordain for you imperishable and glorious heaven, brahmin.'

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा तु भगवान्वरेण्यो वृषवाहनः ।
महेश्वरो महाराज कृत्तिवासा महाद्युतिः ।
सगणो दैवतश्रेष्ठस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥

meaning.en: Having said so, the blessed Maheshvara, the best, bull-mounted, clad in a hide and of great radiance, the best of gods, vanished there with his hosts, great king.

verses.text: गालव उवाच

meaning.en: Galava said:

verses.text:
विश्वामित्राभ्यनुज्ञातो ह्यहं पितरमागतः ।
अब्रवीन्मां ततो माता दुःखिता रुदती भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: With Vishvamitra's leave I came to my father, and my mother, grieved and weeping greatly, said to me:

verses.text:
कौशिकेनाभ्यनुज्ञातं पुत्रं वेदविभूषितम् ।
न तात तरुणं दान्तं पिता त्वां पश्यतेऽनघ ॥

meaning.en: 'Son, you who are adorned with the Vedas have been permitted by Kaushika. But your father, sinless dear one, does not see you as a young self-controlled man.'

verses.text:
श्रुत्वा जनन्या वचनं निराशो गुरुदर्शने ।
नियतात्मा महादेवमपश्यं सोऽब्रवीच्च माम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing my mother's words and despairing of seeing my teacher, I restrained myself and saw Mahadeva, and he spoke to me.

verses.text:
पिता माता च ते त्वं च पुत्र मृत्युविवर्जिताः ।
भविष्यथ विश क्षिप्रं द्रष्टासि पितरं क्षये ॥

meaning.en: 'Son, your father, mother and you will be free of death. Go in quickly; you will see your father in the house.'

verses.text:
अनुज्ञातो भगवता गृहं गत्वा युधिष्ठिर ।
अपश्यं पितरं तात इष्टिं कृत्वा विनिःसृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Given leave by the Blessed One, Yudhishthira, I went home and saw my father, dear, who had finished his sacrifice and come out.

verses.text:
उपस्पृश्य गृहीत्वेध्मं कुशांश्च शरणाद्गुरून् ।
तान्विसृज्य च मां प्राह पिता सास्राविलेक्षणः ॥

meaning.en: Having rinsed his mouth, he had taken fuel and kusha grass, and he dismissed the teachers from his refuge; then my father spoke to me with tear-filled eyes.

verses.text:
प्रणमन्तं परिष्वज्य मूर्ध्नि चाघ्राय पाण्डव ।
दिष्ट्या दृष्टोऽसि मे पुत्र कृतविद्य इहागतः ॥

meaning.en: As I bowed, he embraced me and kissed my head, Pandava, saying, 'By good fortune I see you, my son, come home with your learning complete.'

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एतान्यत्यद्भुतान्येव कर्माण्यथ महात्मनः ।
प्रोक्तानि मुनिभिः श्रुत्वा विस्मयामास पाण्डवः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing these most wonderful deeds of the great-souled one recited by the sages, the Pandava was amazed.

verses.text:
ततः कृष्णोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं पुनर्मतिमतां वरः ।
युधिष्ठिरं धर्मनित्यं पुरुहूतमिवेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: Then Krishna, best of the wise, spoke again to Yudhishthira, ever devoted to dharma, as the lord might speak to Indra.

verses.text:
आदित्यचन्द्रावनिलानलौ च
द्यौर्भूमिरापो वसवोऽथ विश्वे ।
धातार्यमा शुक्रबृहस्पती च
रुद्राः ससाध्या वरुणो वित्तगोपः ॥

meaning.en: The sun and moon, wind and fire, heaven, earth, waters, the Vasus, the Vishvedevas, Dhata, Aryaman, Shukra and Brihaspati, the Rudras with the Sadhyas, Varuna, and the guardian of wealth;

verses.text:
ब्रह्मा शक्रो मारुतो ब्रह्म सत्यं
वेदा यज्ञा दक्षिणा वेदवाहाः ।
सोमो यष्टा यच्च हव्यं हविश्च
रक्षा दीक्षा नियमा ये च केचित् ॥

meaning.en: Brahma, Indra, the Maruts, Brahman, truth, the Vedas, sacrifices, gifts, the bearers of the Vedas, Soma, the sacrificer, the offering and the oblation, protection, consecration, and whatever rules there are;

verses.text:
स्वाहा वषड्ब्राह्मणाः सौरभेया
धर्मं चक्रं कालचक्रं चरं च ।
यशो दमो बुद्धिमती स्थितिश्च
शुभाशुभं मुनयश्चैव सप्त ॥

meaning.en: Svaha, Vashat, the brahmins, the cows, dharma, the wheel, the wheel of time, the moving, fame, self-control, the intelligent mind, stability, good and evil, and the seven sages;

verses.text:
अग्र्या बुद्धिर्मनसा दर्शने च
स्पर्शे सिद्धिः कर्मणां या च सिद्धिः ।
गणा देवानामूष्मपाः सोमपाश्च
लेखाः सुयामास्तुषिता ब्रह्मकायाः ॥

meaning.en: the foremost intellect, the mind, sight, touch, success, the success of actions, the hosts of gods who drink steam and Soma, the Lekhas, Suyamas, Tushitas and Brahmakayikas;

verses.text:
आभास्वरा गन्धपा दृष्टिपाश्च
वाचा विरुद्धाश्च मनोविरुद्धाः ।
शुद्धाश्च निर्वाणरताश्च देवाः
स्पर्शाशना दर्शपा आज्यपाश्च ॥

meaning.en: the Abhasvaras, those who drink fragrance and sight, those opposed in speech or in mind, the pure gods devoted to extinction, those who feed on touch, on the new-moon rite and on ghee;

verses.text:
चिन्तागता ये च देवेषु मुख्या
ये चाप्यन्ये देवताश्चाजमीढ ।
सुपर्णगन्धर्वपिशाचदानवा
यक्षास्तथा पन्नगाश्चारणाश्च ॥

meaning.en: those gods who are chief among the gods by thought, and any other gods, Ajamidha, as well as the Suparnas, gandharvas, pishachas, danavas, yakshas, serpents and charanas:

verses.text:
सूक्ष्मं स्थूलं मृदु यच्चाप्यसूक्ष्मं
सुखं दुःखं सुखदुःखान्तरं च ।
सांख्यं योगं यत्पराणां परं च
शर्वाज्जातं विद्धि यत्कीर्तितं मे ॥

meaning.en: know that the subtle and gross, the soft and the not subtle, pleasure, pain and what lies between pleasure and pain, Sankhya, Yoga, and what is supreme of the supreme, all that I have declared are born from Sharva.

verses.text:
तत्संभूता भूतकृतो वरेण्याः
सर्वे देवा भुवनस्यास्य गोपाः ।
आविश्येमां धरणीं येऽभ्यरक्ष-
न्पुरातनीं तस्य देवस्य सृष्टिम् ॥

meaning.en: Born from him, the makers of beings, the best, all the gods who guard this world, entered this earth and protected this ancient creation of that God.

verses.text:
विचिन्वन्तं मनसा तोष्टुवीमि
किंचित्तत्त्वं प्राणहेतोर्नतोऽस्मि ।
ददातु देवः स वरानिहेष्टा-
नभिष्टुतो नः प्रभुरव्ययः सदा ॥

meaning.en: Seeking some truth with my mind, I praise him; I bow for the sake of life. May that eternal imperishable Lord, praised by us, grant the boons we wish here.

verses.text:
इमं स्तवं संनियम्येन्द्रियाणि
शुचिर्भूत्वा यः पुरुषः पठेत ।
अभग्नयोगो नियतोऽब्दमेकं
स प्राप्नुयादश्वमेधे फलं यत् ॥

meaning.en: A man who, with senses restrained and pure, recites this hymn without breaking yoga and with discipline for one year obtains the fruit of the horse sacrifice.

verses.text:
वेदान्कृत्स्नान्ब्राह्मणः प्राप्नुयाच्च
जयेद्राजा पृथिवीं चापि कृत्स्नाम् ।
वैश्यो लाभं प्राप्नुयान्नैपुणं च
शूद्रो गतिं प्रेत्य तथा सुखं च ॥

meaning.en: A brahmin would master all the Vedas, a king would conquer the whole earth, a vaishya would gain profit and skill, and a shudra after death would gain a good state and happiness.

verses.text:
स्तवराजमिमं कृत्वा रुद्राय दधिरे मनः ।
सर्वदोषापहं पुण्यं पवित्रं च यशस्विनम् ॥

meaning.en: Having made this king of hymns, they fixed their minds on Rudra. It removes all faults, is holy, purifying and brings fame.

verses.text:
यावन्त्यस्य शरीरेषु रोमकूपाणि भारत ।
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गे वसति मानवः ॥

meaning.en: O Bharata, for as many thousands of years as there are pores on the body, a man dwells in heaven.
